description: Construct-coverage programs for the upstream native JavaScript, Rust, Lean and Rocq grammars. Acceptance means the native grammar builds a construct tree; it is not compiler, kernel or runtime acceptance. Refused programs record exact native-grammar gaps. Receipts record each construct a native construct tree cannot show, with the structural reason checked against the grammar text and an accepted probe program that does not build it.

programs.name: rocq-29: Theorem tac : forall a b : nat, a = b -> b = a.
programs.source:
Theorem tac : forall a b : nat, a = b -> b = a.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  destruct a as [|a'] eqn:E; try (symmetry; assumption).
  assert (H2 : b = S a') by (symmetry; exact H).
  match goal with
  | [ H : _ = _ |- _ ] => rewrite <- H in *
  end.
  apply eq_sym; exact H.
Qed.
